subject: Temporary throughput safety-net & pricing framework for ClearHealth launch
messages:
From: Amanda Lewis <amanda@clearhealth.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming launch — short-term throughput ask + overrun options

Connor —

Quick heads-up: we have a customer-facing product launch scheduled for next Thursday (08/20) and the traffic forecast shows a possible 3–4x spike for ~48 hours. We expect the surge to be concentrated in two bursts (morning and evening windows).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short-term throughput uplift (temporary quota bump) and what are the activation lead times?
- If we go over committed capacity, how do you typically handle overrun charges / true-ups for a short window? Any possibility of a blended/discounted overrun for a one-off launch event?

I've attached our traffic plan with hourly expectations. If you need peak TPS/token estimates I can extract them. Procurement will need a written MAP/agreement for any uplift and a projected spend cap we can sign off on.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

—Amanda Lewis
Head of Engineering Operations
ClearHealth
Attachment: Q3-launch_traffic_plan.pdf (pdf)
From: connor.obrien@redwood.com
To: Amanda Lewis <amanda@clearhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming launch — short-term throughput ask + overrun options

Amanda — thanks for the context and the plan (looking through the PDF now). We can support a short window uplift; a few operational notes and options so you can pick what fits best: 

Options (48-hour, one-off):
1) Instant headroom (on-demand, no contract change) — enables up to 2.5x baseline quota for 48 hours. Activation: ~2 hours. Overrun billing: pay-as-you-go at the standard overrun rate (no discount).

2) Blended uplift (preferred for launches) — we provision a temporary quota bump and apply a one-time blended overrun rate for that window (one invoice line item). We can offer a 30% reduction off standard overrun pricing if you agree to: (a) a capped uplift window (48 hours) and (b) a short MAP sign-off confirming expected peak and spend cap. Activation: ~6–12 hours to validate routing and cache warming.

3) Reserved short-term commit — if you can commit to a short-term (7–30 day) reserved capacity at a reduced unit rate we can apply an interim credit against the true-up. That path is heavier from procurement but delivers the best unit economics.

For all options we can add an automatic spend cap to avoid unexpected bills. If you share the exact peak tokens/minute and expected peak duration we’ll provide the concrete price math.

Preliminary numbers (ballpark):
- Standard overrun: $0.045 / 1k tokens
- Blended uplift offer (option 2): $0.0315 / 1k tokens (30% off) for overrun volume within the 48-hour window
- Activation fee: $0 (waived for first-time launch events)

Next steps I suggest:
- Amanda: drop the tokens/minute peak and the two-hour windows you mentioned
- Marcus: can you validate the ops lead time and confirm routing for a 48-hour temporary pool?
- Ben: sales follow-up on MAP template and whether finance needs a PO up front (Ben: flag if we need a prepaid escrow).

I attached a short spreadsheet with a couple of uplift scenarios. Happy to hop on a quick call today to go through numbers.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachment: temp_uplift_options.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Amanda Lewis <amanda@clearhealth.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming launch — short-term throughput ask + overrun options

Connor —

Thanks, that helps. Quick answers:
- Peak: ~6.5M tokens/minute sustained for 20 minutes during each burst; baseline average is ~1.8M tokens/minute.
- Expected uplift: ~3.5x baseline across the burst windows (~40 total minutes of highest load across the 48-hour period).
- Procurement note: we can sign a MAP for a one-off uplift but they will want the proposed spend cap in writing and a DocuSign-ready agreement. PO issuance timeline is 24–48 hours once we have the MAP.

Also: would you be able to share a short customer reference that used the blended uplift path? Our Head of Procurement is more comfortable if we can point to a similar launch scenario. Samir at MediQuick (cc'd) ran something similar recently — he can confirm, but if you have a Redwood reference it would speed approvals.

Appreciate the spend cap option — please include maximum cap examples in your next note.

—Amanda
From: connor.obrien@redwood.com
To: Amanda Lewis <amanda@clearhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming launch — short-term throughput ask + overrun options

Amanda — following up with a written proposal and MAP template attached. Apologies for the slightly longer thread — we wanted to validate ops and finance paths. Summary below (final):

Proposal (48-hour blended uplift)
- Window: 48 hours (proposed run: 2026-08-21 00:00 UTC to 2026-08-23 00:00 UTC; flexible if you need local timing)
- Provisioned uplift: up to 2.8x baseline (covers the 3.5x instantaneous peak given our prefix cache + burst smoothing)
- Overrun pricing (blended): $0.033 / 1k tokens for overrun volume during the uplift window
- Spend cap: we will enforce an administrative cap. Suggested example caps: $15k, $30k, $50k — you pick, and we will configure auto-block at the chosen threshold.
- Activation lead time: 6–12 hours (Marcus has signoff for ops routing; Marcus: will confirm once A. accepts)
- MAP & Signature: we attached a fillable MAP and a DocuSign workflow link. Procurement can sign and return; we will treat the signature as authorization to provision.
- Credit: as a courtesy for first-time launch customers we are offering a one-time 10% rebate on billed overrun volume if you provide a short post-launch usage recap within 7 days (simple form).

Customer reference: MediQuick — Samir Patel (samir@mediquick.ai) ran a blended uplift for their April rollout; Samir is cc'd and has agreed to be reached for a short reference.

Deal details for Redwood ops/finance: deal_id RWD-CH-2026-008; HubSpot link included. Ben, please confirm whether we require a PO before provisioning or if DocuSign + MAP signature is sufficient.

Attachments: signed-MAP-template.docx (fillable), uplift-activation-checklist.pdf

If this looks good Amanda, reply with the spend cap you prefer and we'll queue provisioning immediately after DocuSign signature. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call to finalize.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed-MAP-template.docx (docx), uplift-activation-checklist.pdf (pdf)
